page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u0.c1m1.large is an entry-level virtual server instance belonging to the ecs.u0 family. It is configured with 2 vCPUs mapped to 1 physical core of an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance features dedicated CPU allocation with hyper-threading enabled, providing 2 threads per core. It is equipped with 2.0 GB of system memory, yielding a 1.0 GB memory-per-core ratio. This instance does not include local storage or a GPU, and it operates with a baseline network bandwidth of 1 Gbps.

In benchmark evaluations, the ecs.u0.c1m1.large demonstrates performance characteristics that fall into the lower tiers. The stress-ng single-core CPU performance is rated as weak, placing in the bottom 25%, while the multi-core CPU performance falls into the bottom 10%. Memory bandwidth tests show poor results, with read-only small block cached transfers at 81.68 GB/sec and uncached large block read and write speeds below 10 GB/sec. Passmark CPU and memory scores also rank in the bottom 10%, reflecting the resource-constrained nature of the hardware profile.

The instance is suited for lightweight workloads that do not require high memory density or intensive parallel processing. It can support basic tasks such as static web serving, which achieved a throughput of 1.3 GB/sec in testing, or simple key-value store operations, with Redis SET operations reaching 1.48 million operations per second. It is also capable of running small-scale language model inference, processing 124.22 tokens per second for prompts on a 135M model. This server is best utilized for development environments, lightweight utility services, and low-traffic web applications.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u0.c1m1.large is an entry-level, x86_64 architecture virtual server from the ecs.u0 family. It features 2 dedicated vCPUs from an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz, paired with 2.0 GB of system memory. The instance does not include local storage or GPU resources, and it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 1 Gbps. Benchmark results place its CPU and memory performance consistently in the bottom 10% to 25% of tested servers, with a stress-ng single-core score of 1099.89 and a multi-core score of 1457.99. Given its low resource density and modest processing capabilities, this server is qualitatively cost-efficient for lightweight, non-critical workloads. It is best suited for basic static web serving, development environments, and low-demand utility applications.
